attesterManager().notice: The attester-set administrator. A relay installs its attester through the real setters (`enableAttester` / `setSignatureThreshold`) by impersonating this address on a mirror chain.

buildMessage(bytes32,uint32,bytes32,byte.notice: The exact packed message for the given fields. Split out so the layout is a testable pure function, not a side effect of the burn path.

depositForBurn(uint256,uint32,bytes32,ad.notice: CCTP V2 `depositForBurn`. Pulls the token from the caller and emits the packed burn message; the off-chain relay carries it to the destination domain's transmitter.

initialize(uint32,address,address,uint32.notice: One-shot setup; the mirror installer writes this contract's code at its deployment address (`anvil_setCode`) and calls this once.

localDomain().notice: The local CCTP domain (0 on Ethereum, 19 on HyperEVM, …).

localMessageTransmitter().notice: The local transmitter (this contract serves both messenger roles).

localToken().notice: The local token this messenger burns and pays out.

minFee().notice: No fee surface on the mirror: a relay's `maxFee` check stays bounded only by `maxFee < amount`, the same rule production applies when minFee is 0.

receiveMessage(bytes,bytes).notice: CCTP V2 `receiveMessage`. Verifies the attester signature over the raw message digest, guards the nonce, pays out `amount - feeExecuted` of the local token to the mint recipient, and records the message.

remoteTokenMessengers(uint32).notice: The peer messenger per destination domain (bytes32, Circle's spelling).

version().notice: `version()` and `messageBodyVersion()` — the values a V2 relay pins.
